doc.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023

title: Life of Brian arrangement restored thanks to George Harrison
summary: His Always Look on the Bright Side arrangement was cut at the preview and restored at the premier after George Harrison insisted.

blocks.x: Speaking of haven’t seen it yet, do you — at what point before the actual end of a film do you get to see the film and the music together and is there anything that you have the ability to say that’s not what I had in mind?

Usually you get to the cast and crew you know. A very interesting one is actually “Life of Brian.” Because obviously I did the arrangement of “Always Look on the Bright Side of Life” that finishes the film. And I went to the preview and my whole arrangement apart from the rhythm track, it vanished. There was a saxophone solo and a trumpet solo. And being the last thing in the film I was really looking forward to it and I was really depressed. I came out, oh dear you know. But okay that’s what they’ve chosen to do. I then got invited to the premier and my whole arrangement had been put back, everything. And years later I found out that George Harrison, who produced the film, insisted that my arrangement be restored into the film. So thank you, George.
